args.title: Corvid Packaging newsletter — Retail returns logistics (summary)
args.body:
Combined summary of the Corvid Packaging newsletter "Retail returns logistics" (newsletter@corvid.example), the linked article (https://blog.corvid.example/2026/returns), and its tailored companion piece (https://insights.corvid.example/returns/companion?reader=Daniel Brandt&org=Northwind Analytics):

• Newsletter topic: this week's edition covers retail returns logistics, pointing to the full article on Corvid's blog plus a company-tailored companion version.

• Article findings: apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidating returns into regional hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth (20%).

• Companion takeaway: reselling returned goods within 10 days preserved most of the margin, making speed-to-resale the key lever.

Sources: newsletter email; https://blog.corvid.example/2026/returns; https://insights.corvid.example/returns/companion (tailored for Daniel Brandt, Northwind Analytics).
